## Implementation contract

Saved validated choices override project recommendations, which override system defaults. This implementation contract governs static specimens. Resolved tokens in the current export are authoritative values. Component exceptions must name the affected role and reason.

### Ownership and compatibility

- owners: Design System Lead owns token and compatibility policy. Designers own specimens and interaction contracts. Developers own resolver/export/import parity. QA and Accessibility own release evidence. Product teams own domain-specific confidence, privacy and retention policies.
- changes: Change the JSON contract first, regenerate documentation/defaults/catalog/tokens, then run model, DOM and recipient checks. Link the changed finding IDs and evidence in the release review.
- compatibility: Keep hue-named CSS tokens as compatibility aliases while semantic consumers migrate. Additive tokens retain schemaVersion 1. A removed/renamed key or changed stored meaning requires a schema migration, a version bump and a documented replacement before release. Keep the prior reader fixture until the migration is verified.
- deprecation: Record old key, replacement, reason, introduced version, planned removal version and affected consumers. Do not remove a token while an active consumer still uses it. Future records are preserved rather than coerced.
- scope: This is a web design system with one shared workspace profile. Native dp/sp adaptation and real agent execution require separate adapters and acceptance. User-defined colors and responsive exceptions require product-specific rendered verification.

### Storage and recovery

- version: 1
- legacy: Unversioned valid records migrate in memory. Typography headingScaleVersion 2 applies the smaller six-heading scale once to older records, retaining other roles and existing font/color/style metrics. Later custom size edits are retained. Unsupported future records are preserved. The next successful write stamps the migrated version.
- future: Reject unsupported future versions. Preserve raw data. Offer backup and explicit reset.
- invalid: Keep unfinished drafts separate. Invalid drafts neither apply nor save. Storage failures retain an explicitly marked local preview and the last durable record.
- concurrency: A storage event refreshes applied tokens and disables stale editor controls until reload. Never merge simultaneous edits silently.

### Units

- 1rem = 16px at default browser settings. Do not fix the root font size.
- Prefer rem for typography, spacing and control dimensions. Hairline borders and viewport thresholds may use px. Both equivalents appear in Markdown. SVG strokes use viewBox units. Ratios, percentages, columns, timing and weights are unitless or retain their own units.
- Web CSS px/rem are not native dp/sp. A native adapter must map semantic roles, support text scaling and test device density. Native rendering is not shipped by this web library.

### Layers

{"content":0,"sticky":20,"popover":40,"scrim":60,"dialog":70,"toast":80,"tooltip":90,"rules":"Each overlay gets an explicit owner and close/focus-return path. Portal menus out of clipped scroll containers. Nested dialogs stack one scrim per modal owner. Escape closes the top dismissible layer. Tooltips never block actions. Test collision and zoom; do not infer stacking order from shadow size."}

### Acceptance still required

- Compare page, applied tokens, durable record, Machine View and exported instructions.
- Test valid, unfinished, invalid, missing, malformed, legacy and future records. Exercise storage failure, reset, reload and another tab.
- Test 320, 375, 768, 1024 and 1440px widths, 200% zoom, text-spacing overrides, RTL and long/localized labels.
- Use keyboard and screen reader. Confirm focus return, names, values, error associations and status announcements.
- Verify actual rendered text/surface pairs, forced colors, reduced motion, print and exported recipes in a recipient fixture. Source or DOM checks alone are not rendered acceptance.

Create a complete Button component system for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (type, size, content, radius, state) - not as separate one-off components for each variant.

Types (8):
- Primary: The button that carries the main call to action on a screen, like saving a form, submitting a purchase, or confirming a change.
  Rest: background:var(--button-primary-bg-default);color:var(--button-primary-text-default);
  Hover: background:var(--button-primary-bg-hover);color:var(--button-primary-text-hover);
  Pressed: background:var(--button-primary-bg-active);color:var(--button-primary-text-active);
- Secondary: A supporting action that sits alongside a Primary button, like canceling, going back, or exporting.
  Rest: background:#e3e3df;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#c7c7c1;
  Pressed: background:#f1f1ee;
- Tertiary: A lower-emphasis action that doesn't need to compete for attention, like learning more or skipping a step.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Ghost: An action placed inside toolbars, cards, or dense layouts where a bordered button would add unnecessary weight, like closing or dismissing something.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#4B5563;
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Neutral: An action that needs clear affordance without strong brand emphasis, like filtering, sorting, or opening options.
  Rest: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#e3e3df;
  Pressed: background:#fbfbfa;
- Link: A navigation-style action that behaves like a hyperlink rather than a boxed command, like viewing details or opening a page.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#ff4253;padding-inline:var(--space-8);
  Hover: text-decoration:underline;
  Pressed: color:#d10215;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff4253, 3px offset, 4px corner radius on the outline.
- Approve: An action that confirms or approves something positive, like approving a request or accepting a change.
  Rest: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.1);color:#2FBF6E;border:2px solid #2FBF6E;
  Hover: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.16);
  Pressed: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.26);
  Focus: 2px outline in #2fbf6e (fixed approve color, not the brand color), 2px offset.
- Delete: An action with irreversible consequences, like deleting a record or discarding unsaved work.
  Rest: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.1);color:#FF031A;border:2px solid #FF031A;
  Hover: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.16);color:#FF3F4F;border-color:#FF3F4F;
  Pressed: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.26);color:#D80016;border-color:#D80016;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff031a (fixed danger color, not the brand color), 2px offset.

States (5, apply to every type): Rest, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled.
- Focus (default, see per-type exceptions above): 2px outline in #ff4253, 2px offset - never just a color change, so layout never shifts.
- Disabled: 40% opacity, not-allowed cursor - except Primary at 45% opacity, and Link additionally drops its underline.

What size do you want? (24px - XXS / 28px - XS / 32px - S / 36px - SM / 40px - M / 44px - L / 48px - XL / 56px - XXL) Padding and font-size scale proportionally with height.

Content: Icon left - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Icon only requires an accessible label for screen readers (e.g. aria-label), since there is no visible text.

What corner radius do you want? (0px - Sharp / 4px - Compact / 8px - Balanced / 12px - Soft / Full - Pill) Applied uniformly across every type.

## Implementation contract

Saved validated choices override project recommendations, which override system defaults. This implementation contract governs static specimens. Resolved tokens in the current export are authoritative values. Component exceptions must name the affected role and reason.

### Ownership and compatibility

- owners: Design System Lead owns token and compatibility policy. Designers own specimens and interaction contracts. Developers own resolver/export/import parity. QA and Accessibility own release evidence. Product teams own domain-specific confidence, privacy and retention policies.
- changes: Change the JSON contract first, regenerate documentation/defaults/catalog/tokens, then run model, DOM and recipient checks. Link the changed finding IDs and evidence in the release review.
- compatibility: Keep hue-named CSS tokens as compatibility aliases while semantic consumers migrate. Additive tokens retain schemaVersion 1. A removed/renamed key or changed stored meaning requires a schema migration, a version bump and a documented replacement before release. Keep the prior reader fixture until the migration is verified.
- deprecation: Record old key, replacement, reason, introduced version, planned removal version and affected consumers. Do not remove a token while an active consumer still uses it. Future records are preserved rather than coerced.
- scope: This is a web design system with one shared workspace profile. Native dp/sp adaptation and real agent execution require separate adapters and acceptance. User-defined colors and responsive exceptions require product-specific rendered verification.

### Storage and recovery

- version: 1
- legacy: Unversioned valid records migrate in memory. Typography headingScaleVersion 2 applies the smaller six-heading scale once to older records, retaining other roles and existing font/color/style metrics. Later custom size edits are retained. Unsupported future records are preserved. The next successful write stamps the migrated version.
- future: Reject unsupported future versions. Preserve raw data. Offer backup and explicit reset.
- invalid: Keep unfinished drafts separate. Invalid drafts neither apply nor save. Storage failures retain an explicitly marked local preview and the last durable record.
- concurrency: A storage event refreshes applied tokens and disables stale editor controls until reload. Never merge simultaneous edits silently.

### Units

- 1rem = 16px at default browser settings. Do not fix the root font size.
- Prefer rem for typography, spacing and control dimensions. Hairline borders and viewport thresholds may use px. Both equivalents appear in Markdown. SVG strokes use viewBox units. Ratios, percentages, columns, timing and weights are unitless or retain their own units.
- Web CSS px/rem are not native dp/sp. A native adapter must map semantic roles, support text scaling and test device density. Native rendering is not shipped by this web library.

### Layers

{"content":0,"sticky":20,"popover":40,"scrim":60,"dialog":70,"toast":80,"tooltip":90,"rules":"Each overlay gets an explicit owner and close/focus-return path. Portal menus out of clipped scroll containers. Nested dialogs stack one scrim per modal owner. Escape closes the top dismissible layer. Tooltips never block actions. ### Acceptance still required

- Compare page, applied tokens, durable record, Machine View and exported instructions.
- Test valid, unfinished, invalid, missing, malformed, legacy and future records. Exercise storage failure, reset, reload and another tab.
- Test 320, 375, 768, 1024 and 1440px widths, 200% zoom, text-spacing overrides, RTL and long/localized labels.
- Use keyboard and screen reader. Confirm focus return, names, values, error associations and status announcements.
- Verify actual rendered text/surface pairs, forced colors, reduced motion, print and exported recipes in a recipient fixture. Source or DOM checks alone are not rendered acceptance.

Create a complete Button component system for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (type, size, content, radius, state) - not as separate one-off components for each variant.

Types (8):
- Primary: The button that carries the main call to action on a screen, like saving a form, submitting a purchase, or confirming a change.
  Rest: background:var(--button-primary-bg-default);color:var(--button-primary-text-default);
  Hover: background:var(--button-primary-bg-hover);color:var(--button-primary-text-hover);
  Pressed: background:var(--button-primary-bg-active);color:var(--button-primary-text-active);
- Secondary: A supporting action that sits alongside a Primary button, like canceling, going back, or exporting.
  Rest: background:#e3e3df;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#c7c7c1;
  Pressed: background:#f1f1ee;
- Tertiary: A lower-emphasis action that doesn't need to compete for attention, like learning more or skipping a step.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Ghost: An action placed inside toolbars, cards, or dense layouts where a bordered button would add unnecessary weight, like closing or dismissing something.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#4B5563;
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Neutral: An action that needs clear affordance without strong brand emphasis, like filtering, sorting, or opening options.
  Rest: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#e3e3df;
  Pressed: background:#fbfbfa;
- Link: A navigation-style action that behaves like a hyperlink rather than a boxed command, like viewing details or opening a page.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#ff4253;padding-inline:var(--space-8);
  Hover: text-decoration:underline;
  Pressed: color:#d10215;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff4253, 3px offset, 4px corner radius on the outline.
- Approve: An action that confirms or approves something positive, like approving a request or accepting a change.
  Rest: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.1);color:#2FBF6E;border:2px solid #2FBF6E;
  Hover: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.16);
  Pressed: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.26);
  Focus: 2px outline in #2fbf6e (fixed approve color, not the brand color), 2px offset.
- Delete: An action with irreversible consequences, like deleting a record or discarding unsaved work.
  Rest: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.1);color:#FF031A;border:2px solid #FF031A;
  Hover: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.16);color:#FF3F4F;border-color:#FF3F4F;
  Pressed: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.26);color:#D80016;border-color:#D80016;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff031a (fixed danger color, not the brand color), 2px offset.

States (5, apply to every type): Rest, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled.
- Focus (default, see per-type exceptions above): 2px outline in #ff4253, 2px offset - never just a color change, so layout never shifts.
- Disabled: 40% opacity, not-allowed cursor - except Primary at 45% opacity, and Link additionally drops its underline.

What size do you want? (24px - XXS / 28px - XS / 32px - S / 36px - SM / 40px - M / 44px - L / 48px - XL / 56px - XXL) Padding and font-size scale proportionally with height.

Content: Icon right - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Icon only requires an accessible label for screen readers (e.g. aria-label), since there is no visible text.

What corner radius do you want? (0px - Sharp / 4px - Compact / 8px - Balanced / 12px - Soft / Full - Pill) Applied uniformly across every type.

### Ownership and compatibility

- owners: Design System Lead owns token and compatibility policy. Designers own specimens and interaction contracts. Developers own resolver/export/import parity. QA and Accessibility own release evidence. Product teams own domain-specific confidence, privacy and retention policies.
- changes: Change the JSON contract first, regenerate documentation/defaults/catalog/tokens, then run model, DOM and recipient checks. Link the changed finding IDs and evidence in the release review.
- compatibility: Keep hue-named CSS tokens as compatibility aliases while semantic consumers migrate. Additive tokens retain schemaVersion 1. A removed/renamed key or changed stored meaning requires a schema migration, a version bump and a documented replacement before release. Keep the prior reader fixture until the migration is verified.
- deprecation: Record old key, replacement, reason, introduced version, planned removal version and affected consumers. Do not remove a token while an active consumer still uses it. Future records are preserved rather than coerced.
- scope: This is a web design system with one shared workspace profile. Native dp/sp adaptation and real agent execution require separate adapters and acceptance. User-defined colors and responsive exceptions require product-specific rendered verification.

### Storage and recovery

- version: 1
- legacy: Unversioned valid records migrate in memory. Typography headingScaleVersion 2 applies the smaller six-heading scale once to older records, retaining other roles and existing font/color/style metrics. Later custom size edits are retained. Unsupported future records are preserved. The next successful write stamps the migrated version.
- future: Reject unsupported future versions. Preserve raw data. Offer backup and explicit reset.
- invalid: Keep unfinished drafts separate. Invalid drafts neither apply nor save. Storage failures retain an explicitly marked local preview and the last durable record.
- concurrency: A storage event refreshes applied tokens and disables stale editor controls until reload. Never merge simultaneous edits silently.

### Units

- 1rem = 16px at default browser settings. Do not fix the root font size.
- Prefer rem for typography, spacing and control dimensions. Hairline borders and viewport thresholds may use px. Both equivalents appear in Markdown. SVG strokes use viewBox units. Ratios, percentages, columns, timing and weights are unitless or retain their own units.
- Web CSS px/rem are not native dp/sp. A native adapter must map semantic roles, support text scaling and test device density. Native rendering is not shipped by this web library.

Create a complete Button component system for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (type, size, content, radius, state) - not as separate one-off components for each variant.

Types (8):
- Primary: The button that carries the main call to action on a screen, like saving a form, submitting a purchase, or confirming a change.
  Rest: background:var(--button-primary-bg-default);color:var(--button-primary-text-default);
  Hover: background:var(--button-primary-bg-hover);color:var(--button-primary-text-hover);
  Pressed: background:var(--button-primary-bg-active);color:var(--button-primary-text-active);
- Secondary: A supporting action that sits alongside a Primary button, like canceling, going back, or exporting.
  Rest: background:#e3e3df;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#c7c7c1;
  Pressed: background:#f1f1ee;
- Tertiary: A lower-emphasis action that doesn't need to compete for attention, like learning more or skipping a step.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Ghost: An action placed inside toolbars, cards, or dense layouts where a bordered button would add unnecessary weight, like closing or dismissing something.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#4B5563;
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Neutral: An action that needs clear affordance without strong brand emphasis, like filtering, sorting, or opening options.
  Rest: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#e3e3df;
  Pressed: background:#fbfbfa;
- Link: A navigation-style action that behaves like a hyperlink rather than a boxed command, like viewing details or opening a page.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#ff4253;padding-inline:var(--space-8);
  Hover: text-decoration:underline;
  Pressed: color:#d10215;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff4253, 3px offset, 4px corner radius on the outline.
- Approve: An action that confirms or approves something positive, like approving a request or accepting a change.
  Rest: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.1);color:#2FBF6E;border:2px solid #2FBF6E;
  Hover: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.16);
  Pressed: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.26);
  Focus: 2px outline in #2fbf6e (fixed approve color, not the brand color), 2px offset.
- Delete: An action with irreversible consequences, like deleting a record or discarding unsaved work.
  Rest: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.1);color:#FF031A;border:2px solid #FF031A;
  Hover: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.16);color:#FF3F4F;border-color:#FF3F4F;
  Pressed: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.26);color:#D80016;border-color:#D80016;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff031a (fixed danger color, not the brand color), 2px offset.

States (5, apply to every type): Rest, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled.
- Focus (default, see per-type exceptions above): 2px outline in #ff4253, 2px offset - never just a color change, so layout never shifts.
- Disabled: 40% opacity, not-allowed cursor - except Primary at 45% opacity, and Link additionally drops its underline.

What size do you want? (24px - XXS / 28px - XS / 32px - S / 36px - SM / 40px - M / 44px - L / 48px - XL / 56px - XXL) Padding and font-size scale proportionally with height.

Content: Icon both sides - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Icon only requires an accessible label for screen readers (e.g. aria-label), since there is no visible text.

What corner radius do you want? (0px - Sharp / 4px - Compact / 8px - Balanced / 12px - Soft / Full - Pill) Applied uniformly across every type.

## Implementation contract

Saved validated choices override project recommendations, which override system defaults. This implementation contract governs static specimens. Resolved tokens in the current export are authoritative values. Component exceptions must name the affected role and reason.

### Ownership and compatibility

- owners: Design System Lead owns token and compatibility policy. Designers own specimens and interaction contracts. Developers own resolver/export/import parity. QA and Accessibility own release evidence. Product teams own domain-specific confidence, privacy and retention policies.
- changes: Change the JSON contract first, regenerate documentation/defaults/catalog/tokens, then run model, DOM and recipient checks. Link the changed finding IDs and evidence in the release review.
- compatibility: Keep hue-named CSS tokens as compatibility aliases while semantic consumers migrate. Additive tokens retain schemaVersion 1. A removed/renamed key or changed stored meaning requires a schema migration, a version bump and a documented replacement before release. Keep the prior reader fixture until the migration is verified.
- deprecation: Record old key, replacement, reason, introduced version, planned removal version and affected consumers. Do not remove a token while an active consumer still uses it. Future records are preserved rather than coerced.
- scope: This is a web design system with one shared workspace profile. Native dp/sp adaptation and real agent execution require separate adapters and acceptance. User-defined colors and responsive exceptions require product-specific rendered verification.

### Storage and recovery

- version: 1
- legacy: Unversioned valid records migrate in memory. Typography headingScaleVersion 2 applies the smaller six-heading scale once to older records, retaining other roles and existing font/color/style metrics. Later custom size edits are retained. Unsupported future records are preserved. The next successful write stamps the migrated version.
- future: Reject unsupported future versions. Preserve raw data. Offer backup and explicit reset.
- invalid: Keep unfinished drafts separate. Invalid drafts neither apply nor save. Storage failures retain an explicitly marked local preview and the last durable record.
- concurrency: A storage event refreshes applied tokens and disables stale editor controls until reload. Never merge simultaneous edits silently.

### Units

- 1rem = 16px at default browser settings. Do not fix the root font size.
- Prefer rem for typography, spacing and control dimensions. Hairline borders and viewport thresholds may use px. Both equivalents appear in Markdown. SVG strokes use viewBox units. Ratios, percentages, columns, timing and weights are unitless or retain their own units.
- Web CSS px/rem are not native dp/sp. A native adapter must map semantic roles, support text scaling and test device density. Native rendering is not shipped by this web library.

Create a complete Button component system for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (type, size, content, radius, state) - not as separate one-off components for each variant.

Types (8):
- Primary: The button that carries the main call to action on a screen, like saving a form, submitting a purchase, or confirming a change.
  Rest: background:var(--button-primary-bg-default);color:var(--button-primary-text-default);
  Hover: background:var(--button-primary-bg-hover);color:var(--button-primary-text-hover);
  Pressed: background:var(--button-primary-bg-active);color:var(--button-primary-text-active);
- Secondary: A supporting action that sits alongside a Primary button, like canceling, going back, or exporting.
  Rest: background:#e3e3df;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#c7c7c1;
  Pressed: background:#f1f1ee;
- Tertiary: A lower-emphasis action that doesn't need to compete for attention, like learning more or skipping a step.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Ghost: An action placed inside toolbars, cards, or dense layouts where a bordered button would add unnecessary weight, like closing or dismissing something.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#4B5563;
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Neutral: An action that needs clear affordance without strong brand emphasis, like filtering, sorting, or opening options.
  Rest: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#e3e3df;
  Pressed: background:#fbfbfa;
- Link: A navigation-style action that behaves like a hyperlink rather than a boxed command, like viewing details or opening a page.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#ff4253;padding-inline:var(--space-8);
  Hover: text-decoration:underline;
  Pressed: color:#d10215;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff4253, 3px offset, 4px corner radius on the outline.
- Approve: An action that confirms or approves something positive, like approving a request or accepting a change.
  Rest: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.1);color:#2FBF6E;border:2px solid #2FBF6E;
  Hover: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.16);
  Pressed: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.26);
  Focus: 2px outline in #2fbf6e (fixed approve color, not the brand color), 2px offset.
- Delete: An action with irreversible consequences, like deleting a record or discarding unsaved work.
  Rest: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.1);color:#FF031A;border:2px solid #FF031A;
  Hover: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.16);color:#FF3F4F;border-color:#FF3F4F;
  Pressed: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.26);color:#D80016;border-color:#D80016;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff031a (fixed danger color, not the brand color), 2px offset.

States (5, apply to every type): Rest, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled.
- Focus (default, see per-type exceptions above): 2px outline in #ff4253, 2px offset - never just a color change, so layout never shifts.
- Disabled: 40% opacity, not-allowed cursor - except Primary at 45% opacity, and Link additionally drops its underline.

What size do you want? (24px - XXS / 28px - XS / 32px - S / 36px - SM / 40px - M / 44px - L / 48px - XL / 56px - XXL) Padding and font-size scale proportionally with height.

Content: Icon only - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Icon only requires an accessible label for screen readers (e.g. aria-label), since there is no visible text.

What corner radius do you want? (0px - Sharp / 4px - Compact / 8px - Balanced / 12px - Soft / Full - Pill) Applied uniformly across every type.

## Implementation contract

Saved validated choices override project recommendations, which override system defaults. This implementation contract governs static specimens. Resolved tokens in the current export are authoritative values. Component exceptions must name the affected role and reason.

### Ownership and compatibility

- owners: Design System Lead owns token and compatibility policy. Designers own specimens and interaction contracts. Developers own resolver/export/import parity. QA and Accessibility own release evidence. Product teams own domain-specific confidence, privacy and retention policies.
- changes: Change the JSON contract first, regenerate documentation/defaults/catalog/tokens, then run model, DOM and recipient checks. Link the changed finding IDs and evidence in the release review.
- compatibility: Keep hue-named CSS tokens as compatibility aliases while semantic consumers migrate. Additive tokens retain schemaVersion 1. A removed/renamed key or changed stored meaning requires a schema migration, a version bump and a documented replacement before release. Keep the prior reader fixture until the migration is verified.
- deprecation: Record old key, replacement, reason, introduced version, planned removal version and affected consumers. Do not remove a token while an active consumer still uses it. Future records are preserved rather than coerced.
- scope: This is a web design system with one shared workspace profile. Native dp/sp adaptation and real agent execution require separate adapters and acceptance. User-defined colors and responsive exceptions require product-specific rendered verification.

### Storage and recovery

- version: 1
- legacy: Unversioned valid records migrate in memory. Typography headingScaleVersion 2 applies the smaller six-heading scale once to older records, retaining other roles and existing font/color/style metrics. Later custom size edits are retained. Unsupported future records are preserved. The next successful write stamps the migrated version.
- future: Reject unsupported future versions. Preserve raw data. Offer backup and explicit reset.
- invalid: Keep unfinished drafts separate. Invalid drafts neither apply nor save. Storage failures retain an explicitly marked local preview and the last durable record.
- concurrency: A storage event refreshes applied tokens and disables stale editor controls until reload. Never merge simultaneous edits silently.

### Units

- 1rem = 16px at default browser settings. Do not fix the root font size.
- Prefer rem for typography, spacing and control dimensions. Hairline borders and viewport thresholds may use px. Both equivalents appear in Markdown. SVG strokes use viewBox units. Ratios, percentages, columns, timing and weights are unitless or retain their own units.
- Web CSS px/rem are not native dp/sp. A native adapter must map semantic roles, support text scaling and test device density. Native rendering is not shipped by this web library.

Create a complete Button component system for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (type, size, content, radius, state) - not as separate one-off components for each variant.

Types (8):
- Primary: The button that carries the main call to action on a screen, like saving a form, submitting a purchase, or confirming a change.
  Rest: background:var(--button-primary-bg-default);color:var(--button-primary-text-default);
  Hover: background:var(--button-primary-bg-hover);color:var(--button-primary-text-hover);
  Pressed: background:var(--button-primary-bg-active);color:var(--button-primary-text-active);
- Secondary: A supporting action that sits alongside a Primary button, like canceling, going back, or exporting.
  Rest: background:#e3e3df;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#c7c7c1;
  Pressed: background:#f1f1ee;
- Tertiary: A lower-emphasis action that doesn't need to compete for attention, like learning more or skipping a step.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Ghost: An action placed inside toolbars, cards, or dense layouts where a bordered button would add unnecessary weight, like closing or dismissing something.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#4B5563;
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Neutral: An action that needs clear affordance without strong brand emphasis, like filtering, sorting, or opening options.
  Rest: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#e3e3df;
  Pressed: background:#fbfbfa;
- Link: A navigation-style action that behaves like a hyperlink rather than a boxed command, like viewing details or opening a page.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#ff4253;padding-inline:var(--space-8);
  Hover: text-decoration:underline;
  Pressed: color:#d10215;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff4253, 3px offset, 4px corner radius on the outline.
- Approve: An action that confirms or approves something positive, like approving a request or accepting a change.
  Rest: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.1);color:#2FBF6E;border:2px solid #2FBF6E;
  Hover: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.16);
  Pressed: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.26);
  Focus: 2px outline in #2fbf6e (fixed approve color, not the brand color), 2px offset.
- Delete: An action with irreversible consequences, like deleting a record or discarding unsaved work.
  Rest: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.1);color:#FF031A;border:2px solid #FF031A;
  Hover: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.16);color:#FF3F4F;border-color:#FF3F4F;
  Pressed: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.26);color:#D80016;border-color:#D80016;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff031a (fixed danger color, not the brand color), 2px offset.

States (5, apply to every type): Rest, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled.
- Focus (default, see per-type exceptions above): 2px outline in #ff4253, 2px offset - never just a color change, so layout never shifts.
- Disabled: 40% opacity, not-allowed cursor - except Primary at 45% opacity, and Link additionally drops its underline.

What size do you want? (24px - XXS / 28px - XS / 32px - S / 36px - SM / 40px - M / 44px - L / 48px - XL / 56px - XXL) Padding and font-size scale proportionally with height.

What content do you want? (Text only / Icon left / Icon right / Icon both sides / Icon only) Icon only requires an accessible label for screen readers (e.g. aria-label), since there is no visible text.

What corner radius do you want? (0px - Sharp / 4px - Compact / 8px - Balanced / 12px - Soft / Full - Pill) Applied uniformly across every type.

## Implementation contract

Saved validated choices override project recommendations, which override system defaults. This implementation contract governs static specimens. Resolved tokens in the current export are authoritative values. Component exceptions must name the affected role and reason.

### Ownership and compatibility

- owners: Design System Lead owns token and compatibility policy. Designers own specimens and interaction contracts. Developers own resolver/export/import parity. QA and Accessibility own release evidence. Product teams own domain-specific confidence, privacy and retention policies.
- changes: Change the JSON contract first, regenerate documentation/defaults/catalog/tokens, then run model, DOM and recipient checks. Link the changed finding IDs and evidence in the release review.
- compatibility: Keep hue-named CSS tokens as compatibility aliases while semantic consumers migrate. Additive tokens retain schemaVersion 1. A removed/renamed key or changed stored meaning requires a schema migration, a version bump and a documented replacement before release. Keep the prior reader fixture until the migration is verified.
- deprecation: Record old key, replacement, reason, introduced version, planned removal version and affected consumers. Do not remove a token while an active consumer still uses it. Future records are preserved rather than coerced.
- scope: This is a web design system with one shared workspace profile. Native dp/sp adaptation and real agent execution require separate adapters and acceptance. User-defined colors and responsive exceptions require product-specific rendered verification.

### Storage and recovery

- version: 1
- legacy: Unversioned valid records migrate in memory. Typography headingScaleVersion 2 applies the smaller six-heading scale once to older records, retaining other roles and existing font/color/style metrics. Later custom size edits are retained. Unsupported future records are preserved. The next successful write stamps the migrated version.
- future: Reject unsupported future versions. Preserve raw data. Offer backup and explicit reset.
- invalid: Keep unfinished drafts separate. Invalid drafts neither apply nor save. Storage failures retain an explicitly marked local preview and the last durable record.
- concurrency: A storage event refreshes applied tokens and disables stale editor controls until reload. Never merge simultaneous edits silently.

### Units

- 1rem = 16px at default browser settings. Do not fix the root font size.
- Prefer rem for typography, spacing and control dimensions. Hairline borders and viewport thresholds may use px. Both equivalents appear in Markdown. SVG strokes use viewBox units. Ratios, percentages, columns, timing and weights are unitless or retain their own units.
- Web CSS px/rem are not native dp/sp. A native adapter must map semantic roles, support text scaling and test device density. Native rendering is not shipped by this web library.

Create a complete Button component system for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (type, size, content, radius, state) - not as separate one-off components for each variant.

Types (8):
- Primary: The button that carries the main call to action on a screen, like saving a form, submitting a purchase, or confirming a change.
  Rest: background:var(--button-primary-bg-default);color:var(--button-primary-text-default);
  Hover: background:var(--button-primary-bg-hover);color:var(--button-primary-text-hover);
  Pressed: background:var(--button-primary-bg-active);color:var(--button-primary-text-active);
- Secondary: A supporting action that sits alongside a Primary button, like canceling, going back, or exporting.
  Rest: background:#e3e3df;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#c7c7c1;
  Pressed: background:#f1f1ee;
- Tertiary: A lower-emphasis action that doesn't need to compete for attention, like learning more or skipping a step.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Ghost: An action placed inside toolbars, cards, or dense layouts where a bordered button would add unnecessary weight, like closing or dismissing something.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#4B5563;
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Neutral: An action that needs clear affordance without strong brand emphasis, like filtering, sorting, or opening options.
  Rest: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#e3e3df;
  Pressed: background:#fbfbfa;
- Link: A navigation-style action that behaves like a hyperlink rather than a boxed command, like viewing details or opening a page.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#ff4253;padding-inline:var(--space-8);
  Hover: text-decoration:underline;
  Pressed: color:#d10215;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff4253, 3px offset, 4px corner radius on the outline.
- Approve: An action that confirms or approves something positive, like approving a request or accepting a change.
  Rest: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.1);color:#2FBF6E;border:2px solid #2FBF6E;
  Hover: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.16);
  Pressed: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.26);
  Focus: 2px outline in #2fbf6e (fixed approve color, not the brand color), 2px offset.
- Delete: An action with irreversible consequences, like deleting a record or discarding unsaved work.
  Rest: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.1);color:#FF031A;border:2px solid #FF031A;
  Hover: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.16);color:#FF3F4F;border-color:#FF3F4F;
  Pressed: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.26);color:#D80016;border-color:#D80016;

## Implementation contract

Saved validated choices override project recommendations, which override system defaults. This implementation contract governs static specimens. Resolved tokens in the current export are authoritative values. Component exceptions must name the affected role and reason.

### Ownership and compatibility

- owners: Design System Lead owns token and compatibility policy. Designers own specimens and interaction contracts. Developers own resolver/export/import parity. QA and Accessibility own release evidence. Product teams own domain-specific confidence, privacy and retention policies.
- changes: Change the JSON contract first, regenerate documentation/defaults/catalog/tokens, then run model, DOM and recipient checks. Link the changed finding IDs and evidence in the release review.
- compatibility: Keep hue-named CSS tokens as compatibility aliases while semantic consumers migrate. Additive tokens retain schemaVersion 1. A removed/renamed key or changed stored meaning requires a schema migration, a version bump and a documented replacement before release. Keep the prior reader fixture until the migration is verified.
- deprecation: Record old key, replacement, reason, introduced version, planned removal version and affected consumers. Do not remove a token while an active consumer still uses it. Future records are preserved rather than coerced.
- scope: This is a web design system with one shared workspace profile. Native dp/sp adaptation and real agent execution require separate adapters and acceptance. User-defined colors and responsive exceptions require product-specific rendered verification.

### Storage and recovery

- version: 1
- legacy: Unversioned valid records migrate in memory. Typography headingScaleVersion 2 applies the smaller six-heading scale once to older records, retaining other roles and existing font/color/style metrics. Later custom size edits are retained. Unsupported future records are preserved. The next successful write stamps the migrated version.
- future: Reject unsupported future versions. Preserve raw data. Offer backup and explicit reset.
- invalid: Keep unfinished drafts separate. Invalid drafts neither apply nor save. Storage failures retain an explicitly marked local preview and the last durable record.
- concurrency: A storage event refreshes applied tokens and disables stale editor controls until reload. Never merge simultaneous edits silently.

### Units

- 1rem = 16px at default browser settings. Do not fix the root font size.
- Prefer rem for typography, spacing and control dimensions. Hairline borders and viewport thresholds may use px. Both equivalents appear in Markdown. SVG strokes use viewBox units. Ratios, percentages, columns, timing and weights are unitless or retain their own units.
- Web CSS px/rem are not native dp/sp. A native adapter must map semantic roles, support text scaling and test device density. Native rendering is not shipped by this web library.

  Hover: background:#c7c7c1;
  Pressed: background:#f1f1ee;

  Rest: background:transparent;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;

  Hover: background:#e3e3df;
  Pressed: background:#fbfbfa;

## Implementation contract

Saved validated choices override project recommendations, which override system defaults. This implementation contract governs static specimens. Resolved tokens in the current export are authoritative values. Component exceptions must name the affected role and reason.

### Ownership and compatibility

- owners: Design System Lead owns token and compatibility policy. Designers own specimens and interaction contracts. Developers own resolver/export/import parity. QA and Accessibility own release evidence. Product teams own domain-specific confidence, privacy and retention policies.
- changes: Change the JSON contract first, regenerate documentation/defaults/catalog/tokens, then run model, DOM and recipient checks. Link the changed finding IDs and evidence in the release review.
- compatibility: Keep hue-named CSS tokens as compatibility aliases while semantic consumers migrate. Additive tokens retain schemaVersion 1. A removed/renamed key or changed stored meaning requires a schema migration, a version bump and a documented replacement before release. Keep the prior reader fixture until the migration is verified.
- deprecation: Record old key, replacement, reason, introduced version, planned removal version and affected consumers. Do not remove a token while an active consumer still uses it. Future records are preserved rather than coerced.
- scope: This is a web design system with one shared workspace profile. Native dp/sp adaptation and real agent execution require separate adapters and acceptance. User-defined colors and responsive exceptions require product-specific rendered verification.

### Storage and recovery

- version: 1
- legacy: Unversioned valid records migrate in memory. Typography headingScaleVersion 2 applies the smaller six-heading scale once to older records, retaining other roles and existing font/color/style metrics. Later custom size edits are retained. Unsupported future records are preserved. The next successful write stamps the migrated version.
- future: Reject unsupported future versions. Preserve raw data. Offer backup and explicit reset.
- invalid: Keep unfinished drafts separate. Invalid drafts neither apply nor save. Storage failures retain an explicitly marked local preview and the last durable record.
- concurrency: A storage event refreshes applied tokens and disables stale editor controls until reload. Never merge simultaneous edits silently.

### Units

- 1rem = 16px at default browser settings. Do not fix the root font size.
- Prefer rem for typography, spacing and control dimensions. Hairline borders and viewport thresholds may use px. Both equivalents appear in Markdown. SVG strokes use viewBox units. Ratios, percentages, columns, timing and weights are unitless or retain their own units.
- Web CSS px/rem are not native dp/sp. A native adapter must map semantic roles, support text scaling and test device density. Native rendering is not shipped by this web library.

### Layers

Portal menus out of clipped scroll containers. Nested dialogs stack one scrim per modal owner. Escape closes the top dismissible layer. Tooltips never block actions. - Compare page, applied tokens, durable record, Machine View and exported instructions.
- Test valid, unfinished, invalid, missing, malformed, legacy and future records. Exercise storage failure, reset, reload and another tab.
- Test 320, 375, 768, 1024 and 1440px widths, 200% zoom, text-spacing overrides, RTL and long/localized labels.
- Use keyboard and screen reader. Confirm focus return, names, values, error associations and status announcements.

## Implementation contract

Saved validated choices override project recommendations, which override system defaults. This implementation contract governs static specimens. Resolved tokens in the current export are authoritative values. Component exceptions must name the affected role and reason.

### Ownership and compatibility

- owners: Design System Lead owns token and compatibility policy. Designers own specimens and interaction contracts. Developers own resolver/export/import parity. QA and Accessibility own release evidence. Product teams own domain-specific confidence, privacy and retention policies.
- changes: Change the JSON contract first, regenerate documentation/defaults/catalog/tokens, then run model, DOM and recipient checks. Link the changed finding IDs and evidence in the release review.
- compatibility: Keep hue-named CSS tokens as compatibility aliases while semantic consumers migrate. Additive tokens retain schemaVersion 1. A removed/renamed key or changed stored meaning requires a schema migration, a version bump and a documented replacement before release. Keep the prior reader fixture until the migration is verified.
- deprecation: Record old key, replacement, reason, introduced version, planned removal version and affected consumers. Do not remove a token while an active consumer still uses it. Future records are preserved rather than coerced.
- scope: This is a web design system with one shared workspace profile. Native dp/sp adaptation and real agent execution require separate adapters and acceptance. User-defined colors and responsive exceptions require product-specific rendered verification.

### Storage and recovery

- version: 1
- legacy: Unversioned valid records migrate in memory. Typography headingScaleVersion 2 applies the smaller six-heading scale once to older records, retaining other roles and existing font/color/style metrics. Later custom size edits are retained. Unsupported future records are preserved. The next successful write stamps the migrated version.
- future: Reject unsupported future versions. Preserve raw data. Offer backup and explicit reset.
- invalid: Keep unfinished drafts separate. Invalid drafts neither apply nor save. Storage failures retain an explicitly marked local preview and the last durable record.
- concurrency: A storage event refreshes applied tokens and disables stale editor controls until reload. Never merge simultaneous edits silently.

### Units

- 1rem = 16px at default browser settings. Do not fix the root font size.
- Prefer rem for typography, spacing and control dimensions. Hairline borders and viewport thresholds may use px. Both equivalents appear in Markdown. SVG strokes use viewBox units. Ratios, percentages, columns, timing and weights are unitless or retain their own units.
- Web CSS px/rem are not native dp/sp. A native adapter must map semantic roles, support text scaling and test device density. Native rendering is not shipped by this web library.

### Layers

- Compare page, applied tokens, durable record, Machine View and exported instructions.
- Test valid, unfinished, invalid, missing, malformed, legacy and future records. Exercise storage failure, reset, reload and another tab.
- Test 320, 375, 768, 1024 and 1440px widths, 200% zoom, text-spacing overrides, RTL and long/localized labels.
- Use keyboard and screen reader. Confirm focus return, names, values, error associations and status announcements.

- deprecation: Record old key, replacement, reason, introduced version, planned removal version and affected consumers. Do not remove a token while an active consumer still uses it. Future records are preserved rather than coerced.
- scope: This is a web design system with one shared workspace profile. Native dp/sp adaptation and real agent execution require separate adapters and acceptance. User-defined colors and responsive exceptions require product-specific rendered verification.

### Storage and recovery

- version: 1

Create a complete Button component system for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (type, size, content, radius, state) - not as separate one-off components for each variant.

Types (8):
- Primary: The button that carries the main call to action on a screen, like saving a form, submitting a purchase, or confirming a change.
  Rest: background:var(--button-primary-bg-default);color:var(--button-primary-text-default);
  Hover: background:var(--button-primary-bg-hover);color:var(--button-primary-text-hover);
  Pressed: background:var(--button-primary-bg-active);color:var(--button-primary-text-active);
- Secondary: A supporting action that sits alongside a Primary button, like canceling, going back, or exporting.
  Rest: background:#e3e3df;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#c7c7c1;
  Pressed: background:#f1f1ee;
- Tertiary: A lower-emphasis action that doesn't need to compete for attention, like learning more or skipping a step.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Ghost: An action placed inside toolbars, cards, or dense layouts where a bordered button would add unnecessary weight, like closing or dismissing something.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#4B5563;
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Neutral: An action that needs clear affordance without strong brand emphasis, like filtering, sorting, or opening options.
  Rest: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#e3e3df;
  Pressed: background:#fbfbfa;
- Link: A navigation-style action that behaves like a hyperlink rather than a boxed command, like viewing details or opening a page.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#ff4253;padding-inline:var(--space-8);
  Hover: text-decoration:underline;
  Pressed: color:#d10215;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff4253, 3px offset, 4px corner radius on the outline.
- Approve: An action that confirms or approves something positive, like approving a request or accepting a change.
  Rest: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.1);color:#2FBF6E;border:2px solid #2FBF6E;
  Hover: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.16);
  Pressed: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.26);
  Focus: 2px outline in #2fbf6e (fixed approve color, not the brand color), 2px offset.
- Delete: An action with irreversible consequences, like deleting a record or discarding unsaved work.
  Rest: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.1);color:#FF031A;border:2px solid #FF031A;
  Hover: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.16);color:#FF3F4F;border-color:#FF3F4F;
  Pressed: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.26);color:#D80016;border-color:#D80016;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff031a (fixed danger color, not the brand color), 2px offset.

States (5, apply to every type): Rest, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled.
- Focus (default, see per-type exceptions above): 2px outline in #ff4253, 2px offset - never just a color change, so layout never shifts.
- Disabled: 40% opacity, not-allowed cursor - except Primary at 45% opacity, and Link additionally drops its underline.

What size do you want? (24px - XXS / 28px - XS / 32px - S / 36px - SM / 40px - M / 44px - L / 48px - XL / 56px - XXL) Padding and font-size scale proportionally with height.

What content do you want? (Text only / Icon left / Icon right / Icon both sides / Icon only) Icon only requires an accessible label for screen readers (e.g. aria-label), since there is no visible text.

Corner radius: 12px - Soft - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Applied uniformly across every type.

Create a complete Button component system for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (type, size, content, radius, state) - not as separate one-off components for each variant.

Types (8):
- Primary: The button that carries the main call to action on a screen, like saving a form, submitting a purchase, or confirming a change.
  Rest: background:var(--button-primary-bg-default);color:var(--button-primary-text-default);
  Hover: background:var(--button-primary-bg-hover);color:var(--button-primary-text-hover);
  Pressed: background:var(--button-primary-bg-active);color:var(--button-primary-text-active);
- Secondary: A supporting action that sits alongside a Primary button, like canceling, going back, or exporting.
  Rest: background:#e3e3df;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#c7c7c1;
  Pressed: background:#f1f1ee;
- Tertiary: A lower-emphasis action that doesn't need to compete for attention, like learning more or skipping a step.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Ghost: An action placed inside toolbars, cards, or dense layouts where a bordered button would add unnecessary weight, like closing or dismissing something.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#4B5563;
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Neutral: An action that needs clear affordance without strong brand emphasis, like filtering, sorting, or opening options.
  Rest: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#e3e3df;
  Pressed: background:#fbfbfa;
- Link: A navigation-style action that behaves like a hyperlink rather than a boxed command, like viewing details or opening a page.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#ff4253;padding-inline:var(--space-8);
  Hover: text-decoration:underline;
  Pressed: color:#d10215;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff4253, 3px offset, 4px corner radius on the outline.
- Approve: An action that confirms or approves something positive, like approving a request or accepting a change.
  Rest: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.1);color:#2FBF6E;border:2px solid #2FBF6E;
  Hover: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.16);
  Pressed: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.26);
  Focus: 2px outline in #2fbf6e (fixed approve color, not the brand color), 2px offset.
- Delete: An action with irreversible consequences, like deleting a record or discarding unsaved work.
  Rest: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.1);color:#FF031A;border:2px solid #FF031A;
  Hover: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.16);color:#FF3F4F;border-color:#FF3F4F;
  Pressed: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.26);color:#D80016;border-color:#D80016;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff031a (fixed danger color, not the brand color), 2px offset.

States (5, apply to every type): Rest, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled.
- Focus (default, see per-type exceptions above): 2px outline in #ff4253, 2px offset - never just a color change, so layout never shifts.
- Disabled: 40% opacity, not-allowed cursor - except Primary at 45% opacity, and Link additionally drops its underline.

What size do you want? (24px - XXS / 28px - XS / 32px - S / 36px - SM / 40px - M / 44px - L / 48px - XL / 56px - XXL) Padding and font-size scale proportionally with height.

What content do you want? (Text only / Icon left / Icon right / Icon both sides / Icon only) Icon only requires an accessible label for screen readers (e.g. aria-label), since there is no visible text.

Corner radius: Full - Pill - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Applied uniformly across every type.

Create a complete Button component system for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (type, size, content, radius, state) - not as separate one-off components for each variant.

Types (8):
- Primary: The button that carries the main call to action on a screen, like saving a form, submitting a purchase, or confirming a change.
  Rest: background:var(--button-primary-bg-default);color:var(--button-primary-text-default);
  Hover: background:var(--button-primary-bg-hover);color:var(--button-primary-text-hover);
  Pressed: background:var(--button-primary-bg-active);color:var(--button-primary-text-active);
- Secondary: A supporting action that sits alongside a Primary button, like canceling, going back, or exporting.
  Rest: background:#e3e3df;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#c7c7c1;
  Pressed: background:#f1f1ee;
- Tertiary: A lower-emphasis action that doesn't need to compete for attention, like learning more or skipping a step.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Ghost: An action placed inside toolbars, cards, or dense layouts where a bordered button would add unnecessary weight, like closing or dismissing something.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#4B5563;
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Neutral: An action that needs clear affordance without strong brand emphasis, like filtering, sorting, or opening options.
  Rest: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#e3e3df;
  Pressed: background:#fbfbfa;
- Link: A navigation-style action that behaves like a hyperlink rather than a boxed command, like viewing details or opening a page.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#ff4253;padding-inline:var(--space-8);
  Hover: text-decoration:underline;
  Pressed: color:#d10215;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff4253, 3px offset, 4px corner radius on the outline.
- Approve: An action that confirms or approves something positive, like approving a request or accepting a change.
  Rest: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.1);color:#2FBF6E;border:2px solid #2FBF6E;
  Hover: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.16);
  Pressed: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.26);
  Focus: 2px outline in #2fbf6e (fixed approve color, not the brand color), 2px offset.
- Delete: An action with irreversible consequences, like deleting a record or discarding unsaved work.
  Rest: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.1);color:#FF031A;border:2px solid #FF031A;
  Hover: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.16);color:#FF3F4F;border-color:#FF3F4F;
  Pressed: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.26);color:#D80016;border-color:#D80016;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff031a (fixed danger color, not the brand color), 2px offset.

States (5, apply to every type): Rest, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled.
- Focus (default, see per-type exceptions above): 2px outline in #ff4253, 2px offset - never just a color change, so layout never shifts.
- Disabled: 40% opacity, not-allowed cursor - except Primary at 45% opacity, and Link additionally drops its underline.

What size do you want? (24px - XXS / 28px - XS / 32px - S / 36px - SM / 40px - M / 44px - L / 48px - XL / 56px - XXL) Padding and font-size scale proportionally with height.

What content do you want? (Text only / Icon left / Icon right / Icon both sides / Icon only) Icon only requires an accessible label for screen readers (e.g. aria-label), since there is no visible text.

What corner radius do you want? (0px - Sharp / 4px - Compact / 8px - Balanced / 12px - Soft / Full - Pill) Applied uniformly across every type.

## Implementation contract

Saved validated choices override project recommendations, which override system defaults. This implementation contract governs static specimens. Resolved tokens in the current export are authoritative values. Component exceptions must name the affected role and reason.

### Ownership and compatibility

- owners: Design System Lead owns token and compatibility policy. Designers own specimens and interaction contracts. Developers own resolver/export/import parity. QA and Accessibility own release evidence. Product teams own domain-specific confidence, privacy and retention policies.
- changes: Change the JSON contract first, regenerate documentation/defaults/catalog/tokens, then run model, DOM and recipient checks. Link the changed finding IDs and evidence in the release review.
- compatibility: Keep hue-named CSS tokens as compatibility aliases while semantic consumers migrate. Additive tokens retain schemaVersion 1. A removed/renamed key or changed stored meaning requires a schema migration, a version bump and a documented replacement before release. Keep the prior reader fixture until the migration is verified.
- deprecation: Record old key, replacement, reason, introduced version, planned removal version and affected consumers. Do not remove a token while an active consumer still uses it. Future records are preserved rather than coerced.
- scope: This is a web design system with one shared workspace profile. Native dp/sp adaptation and real agent execution require separate adapters and acceptance. User-defined colors and responsive exceptions require product-specific rendered verification.

### Storage and recovery

- version: 1
- legacy: Unversioned valid records migrate in memory. Typography headingScaleVersion 2 applies the smaller six-heading scale once to older records, retaining other roles and existing font/color/style metrics. Later custom size edits are retained. Unsupported future records are preserved. The next successful write stamps the migrated version.
- future: Reject unsupported future versions. Preserve raw data. Offer backup and explicit reset.
- invalid: Keep unfinished drafts separate. Invalid drafts neither apply nor save. Storage failures retain an explicitly marked local preview and the last durable record.
- concurrency: A storage event refreshes applied tokens and disables stale editor controls until reload. Never merge simultaneous edits silently.

### Units

- 1rem = 16px at default browser settings. Do not fix the root font size.
- Prefer rem for typography, spacing and control dimensions. Hairline borders and viewport thresholds may use px. Both equivalents appear in Markdown. SVG strokes use viewBox units. Ratios, percentages, columns, timing and weights are unitless or retain their own units.
- Web CSS px/rem are not native dp/sp. A native adapter must map semantic roles, support text scaling and test device density. Native rendering is not shipped by this web library.

### Layers

Portal menus out of clipped scroll containers. Nested dialogs stack one scrim per modal owner. Escape closes the top dismissible layer. Tooltips never block actions. ### Acceptance still required

- Compare page, applied tokens, durable record, Machine View and exported instructions.
- Test valid, unfinished, invalid, missing, malformed, legacy and future records. Exercise storage failure, reset, reload and another tab.
- Test 320, 375, 768, 1024 and 1440px widths, 200% zoom, text-spacing overrides, RTL and long/localized labels.
- Use keyboard and screen reader. Confirm focus return, names, values, error associations and status announcements.
- Verify actual rendered text/surface pairs, forced colors, reduced motion, print and exported recipes in a recipient fixture. Source or DOM checks alone are not rendered acceptance.

Create a complete Button component system for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (type, size, content, radius, state) - not as separate one-off components for each variant.

Types (8):
- Primary: The button that carries the main call to action on a screen, like saving a form, submitting a purchase, or confirming a change.
  Rest: background:var(--button-primary-bg-default);color:var(--button-primary-text-default);
  Hover: background:var(--button-primary-bg-hover);color:var(--button-primary-text-hover);
  Pressed: background:var(--button-primary-bg-active);color:var(--button-primary-text-active);
- Secondary: A supporting action that sits alongside a Primary button, like canceling, going back, or exporting.
  Rest: background:#e3e3df;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#c7c7c1;
  Pressed: background:#f1f1ee;
- Tertiary: A lower-emphasis action that doesn't need to compete for attention, like learning more or skipping a step.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Ghost: An action placed inside toolbars, cards, or dense layouts where a bordered button would add unnecessary weight, like closing or dismissing something.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#4B5563;
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Neutral: An action that needs clear affordance without strong brand emphasis, like filtering, sorting, or opening options.
  Rest: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#e3e3df;
  Pressed: background:#fbfbfa;
- Link: A navigation-style action that behaves like a hyperlink rather than a boxed command, like viewing details or opening a page.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#ff4253;padding-inline:var(--space-8);
  Hover: text-decoration:underline;
  Pressed: color:#d10215;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff4253, 3px offset, 4px corner radius on the outline.
- Approve: An action that confirms or approves something positive, like approving a request or accepting a change.
  Rest: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.1);color:#2FBF6E;border:2px solid #2FBF6E;
  Hover: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.16);
  Pressed: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.26);
  Focus: 2px outline in #2fbf6e (fixed approve color, not the brand color), 2px offset.
- Delete: An action with irreversible consequences, like deleting a record or discarding unsaved work.
  Rest: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.1);color:#FF031A;border:2px solid #FF031A;
  Hover: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.16);color:#FF3F4F;border-color:#FF3F4F;
  Pressed: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.26);color:#D80016;border-color:#D80016;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff031a (fixed danger color, not the brand color), 2px offset.

States (5, apply to every type): Rest, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled.
- Focus (default, see per-type exceptions above): 2px outline in #ff4253, 2px offset - never just a color change, so layout never shifts.
- Disabled: 40% opacity, not-allowed cursor - except Primary at 45% opacity, and Link additionally drops its underline.

Size: 40px - M - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Padding and font-size scale proportionally with height.

Content: Text only - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Icon only requires an accessible label for screen readers (e.g. aria-label), since there is no visible text.

Corner radius: 0px - Sharp - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Applied uniformly across every type.

## Implementation contract

Saved validated choices override project recommendations, which override system defaults. This implementation contract governs static specimens. Resolved tokens in the current export are authoritative values. Component exceptions must name the affected role and reason.

### Ownership and compatibility

- owners: Design System Lead owns token and compatibility policy. Designers own specimens and interaction contracts. Developers own resolver/export/import parity. QA and Accessibility own release evidence. Product teams own domain-specific confidence, privacy and retention policies.
- changes: Change the JSON contract first, regenerate documentation/defaults/catalog/tokens, then run model, DOM and recipient checks. Link the changed finding IDs and evidence in the release review.
- compatibility: Keep hue-named CSS tokens as compatibility aliases while semantic consumers migrate. Additive tokens retain schemaVersion 1. A removed/renamed key or changed stored meaning requires a schema migration, a version bump and a documented replacement before release. Keep the prior reader fixture until the migration is verified.
- deprecation: Record old key, replacement, reason, introduced version, planned removal version and affected consumers. Do not remove a token while an active consumer still uses it. Future records are preserved rather than coerced.
- scope: This is a web design system with one shared workspace profile. Native dp/sp adaptation and real agent execution require separate adapters and acceptance. User-defined colors and responsive exceptions require product-specific rendered verification.

### Storage and recovery

- version: 1
- legacy: Unversioned valid records migrate in memory. Typography headingScaleVersion 2 applies the smaller six-heading scale once to older records, retaining other roles and existing font/color/style metrics. Later custom size edits are retained. Unsupported future records are preserved. The next successful write stamps the migrated version.
- future: Reject unsupported future versions. Preserve raw data. Offer backup and explicit reset.
- invalid: Keep unfinished drafts separate. Invalid drafts neither apply nor save. Storage failures retain an explicitly marked local preview and the last durable record.
- concurrency: A storage event refreshes applied tokens and disables stale editor controls until reload. Never merge simultaneous edits silently.

### Units

- 1rem = 16px at default browser settings. Do not fix the root font size.
- Prefer rem for typography, spacing and control dimensions. Hairline borders and viewport thresholds may use px. Both equivalents appear in Markdown. SVG strokes use viewBox units. Ratios, percentages, columns, timing and weights are unitless or retain their own units.
- Web CSS px/rem are not native dp/sp. A native adapter must map semantic roles, support text scaling and test device density. Native rendering is not shipped by this web library.

### Layers

{"content":0,"sticky":20,"popover":40,"scrim":60,"dialog":70,"toast":80,"tooltip":90,"rules":"Each overlay gets an explicit owner and close/focus-return path. Portal menus out of clipped scroll containers. Nested dialogs stack one scrim per modal owner. Escape closes the top dismissible layer. Tooltips never block actions. Test collision and zoom; do not infer stacking order from shadow size."}

### Acceptance still required

- Compare page, applied tokens, durable record, Machine View and exported instructions.
- Test valid, unfinished, invalid, missing, malformed, legacy and future records. Exercise storage failure, reset, reload and another tab.
- Test 320, 375, 768, 1024 and 1440px widths, 200% zoom, text-spacing overrides, RTL and long/localized labels.
- Use keyboard and screen reader. Confirm focus return, names, values, error associations and status announcements.
- Verify actual rendered text/surface pairs, forced colors, reduced motion, print and exported recipes in a recipient fixture. Source or DOM checks alone are not rendered acceptance.

Create a complete Button component system for the Agentic Design System.

Build it as ONE reusable component controlled by properties (type, size, content, radius, state) - not as separate one-off components for each variant.

Types (8):
- Primary: The button that carries the main call to action on a screen, like saving a form, submitting a purchase, or confirming a change.
  Rest: background:var(--button-primary-bg-default);color:var(--button-primary-text-default);
  Hover: background:var(--button-primary-bg-hover);color:var(--button-primary-text-hover);
  Pressed: background:var(--button-primary-bg-active);color:var(--button-primary-text-active);
- Secondary: A supporting action that sits alongside a Primary button, like canceling, going back, or exporting.
  Rest: background:#e3e3df;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#c7c7c1;
  Pressed: background:#f1f1ee;
- Tertiary: A lower-emphasis action that doesn't need to compete for attention, like learning more or skipping a step.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Ghost: An action placed inside toolbars, cards, or dense layouts where a bordered button would add unnecessary weight, like closing or dismissing something.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#4B5563;
  Hover: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;
  Pressed: background:#e3e3df;
- Neutral: An action that needs clear affordance without strong brand emphasis, like filtering, sorting, or opening options.
  Rest: background:#f1f1ee;color:#111827;border:1.5px solid rgba(15,15,10,0.15);
  Hover: background:#e3e3df;
  Pressed: background:#fbfbfa;
- Link: A navigation-style action that behaves like a hyperlink rather than a boxed command, like viewing details or opening a page.
  Rest: background:transparent;color:#ff4253;padding-inline:var(--space-8);
  Hover: text-decoration:underline;
  Pressed: color:#d10215;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff4253, 3px offset, 4px corner radius on the outline.
- Approve: An action that confirms or approves something positive, like approving a request or accepting a change.
  Rest: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.1);color:#2FBF6E;border:2px solid #2FBF6E;
  Hover: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.16);
  Pressed: background:rgba(47,191,110,0.26);
  Focus: 2px outline in #2fbf6e (fixed approve color, not the brand color), 2px offset.
- Delete: An action with irreversible consequences, like deleting a record or discarding unsaved work.
  Rest: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.1);color:#FF031A;border:2px solid #FF031A;
  Hover: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.16);color:#FF3F4F;border-color:#FF3F4F;
  Pressed: background:rgba(255,3,26,0.26);color:#D80016;border-color:#D80016;
  Focus: 2px outline in #ff031a (fixed danger color, not the brand color), 2px offset.

States (5, apply to every type): Rest, Hover, Pressed, Focus, Disabled.
- Focus (default, see per-type exceptions above): 2px outline in #ff4253, 2px offset - never just a color change, so layout never shifts.
- Disabled: 40% opacity, not-allowed cursor - except Primary at 45% opacity, and Link additionally drops its underline.

Size: 40px - M - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Padding and font-size scale proportionally with height.

Content: Text only - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Icon only requires an accessible label for screen readers (e.g. aria-label), since there is no visible text.

Corner radius: 0px - Sharp - the user has explicitly chosen this, generate only this option. Applied uniformly across every type.
